text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан wins the Kikuka Sho. She's
come such
a long way.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After, she and Хиши Амадзон confirm
their battle
at the Arima Kinen is still on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And with that, Нарита Брайан sets her
sights on the
Arima Kinen to settle the
score with Hishi
Amazon!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
